messages.en:
Chuggin' {04 14 00}
made my belly go splish.

You're more like a dog
than any dog I know.
messages.et:
Sa oled koeralikum kui
ükski koer, keda tean.

messages.en:
Let's battle, you and me!
{0b 03 00}{04 12 00} style!

I only wear shirts with
{04 15 00} print!
messages.et:
Kannan ainult särke,
millel on {04 15 00} muster!

messages.en:
Next time, I'll prep
{04 13 00} for us!

I set up pitfalls for your
next visit! Ha!
messages.et:
Seadsin su järgmiseks
tulekuks püünisaugud! Haa!

messages.en:
Heh heh! How about you
visit me this weekend?
messages.et:
Heh heh! Kuidas oleks, kui
sa tuleksid nädalavahetusel?

messages.en:
Each town has its own
specialty. Check ours out!
messages.et:
Igal linnal on oma
eripära. Vaata meie oma!

messages.en:
Don't chop down trees in
someone else's town!
messages.et:
Ära raiu puid maha
kellegi teise linnas!

messages.en:
I'll be counting the days
until you visit me again!
messages.et:
Loen päevi, kuni sa
mulle jälle külla tuled!

messages.en:
My niece has been bugging
me to send this to you...
messages.et:
Mu õetütar käis peale,
et saadaksin selle sulle...

messages.en:
The present I've enclosed
will self-destruct.
messages.et:
Kingitus, mille kaasa
panin, hävitab end ise.

messages.en:
I've included a present!
I'll send the invoice soon.
messages.et:
Panin kingituse kaasa!
Arve saadan varsti.

messages.en:
I felt sappy giving this
to you in person, so here!
messages.et:
Mul oleks piinlik seda
isiklikult anda, nii et säh!

messages.en:
I won this at a carnival.
It's yours now.
messages.et:
Võitsin selle laadal.
Nüüd on see sinu.

messages.en:
This present is for the
anniversary of your visit!
messages.et:
See kingitus on sinu
külaskäigu aastapäevaks!
